may_read: research/adapter_v10/protocol.py, base.py, facade.py, benchmarks.py, stress.py (adapter interfaces)
public literature + official venue/API documentation (record query, retrieval UTC, accepted/rejected sources + reasons)
must_not_read: any V11 family metrics, verdicts beyond mechanism-level forbidden inventory, scored artifacts, terminal reports
isolation_contract.prohibited_computations: no returns, PnL, PF, Sharpe, candidate ranking, backtests, or data queries beyond schema/coverage

task: propose exactly TWO genuinely new low-turnover mechanisms for crypto USD-M perpetuals (JSON+MD under your own prefix research/proposals/v12/<lane>/)

data_schema.universe: 20 Binance USD-M perpetual symbols (BTCUSDT context benchmark only, excluded from books)
fields: funding settlements with fundingTime (mixed 8h/4h/1h cadences on some symbols)
mark price available via bars contract; instrument tick sizes 1e-7..1e-2
data_schema.pit_rules: features from completed bars + last completed OI row strictly before the decision stamp; one declared execution lag after availability

constraints.book_rule: target books must satisfy max |weight| <= 0.30 at every decision stamp by construction
constraints.controls: every family = anchor + theoretically justified neighbour + causal negative control (sign-destroying or mechanism-destroying)

ineligible_mechanism_classes: see research/control/v12_run/forbidden_family_inventory.json (LOT/MAX/skew inversion or variants; Amihud/illiquidity variants — reserved for replication; OI-deleveraging variants — reserved for OILEV-V2; aggressor absorption; funding-carry rescues; ordinary momentum; ordinary reversal; volume-shock continuation; renamed rejected baselines; anything needing unavailable/purchased data)
required_proposal_fields: target book + beta/risk neutralisation + expected turnover
anchor + justified neighbour + causal negative control
why it is neither LOT inversion nor ILLIQ/OILEV parameter rescue
